svg.text: chip dip computer carrier · circuit notes and limits
Exact notes retained from source-bound annotated reference; diagram and hardware acceptance remain OPEN.
UART directions are from the original C.H.I.P symbol: TX U3.43 → host RX; host TX → RX U3.45.
U3.2 CHG-IN receives carrier 5 V; VCC-5V outputs U3.3 / .42 remain separate, unconnected carrier nets.
SW1 grounds PWRON/reset; SW2 grounds FEL. Software behavior requires the matching computer image.
U1 R-78HB5.0-0.5L regulator feeds D1; host P4.2 feeds D2. Diodes join at charging rail; fitted limits unresolved.
U2 DS2431 IO connects U3.17 LCD-D2. Activity Q1/Q2 sense UART; no RS232 level conversion is present.
Missing populated abstract / component art, voltage/current limits, Prime wiring and actual viewer gates remain OPEN.
